purpose: Machine-verifiable companion to apps/desktop/SOURCES.md and docs/release.md: pinned third-party inputs, evidence locations, exact rebuild commands and the still-pending redistribution obligations. Engineering bookkeeping only; not a legal audit or compliance certification.

release.notes: Published as a public prerelease at the repository owner's explicit request. Publication is not a compliance certification; the obligations below remain open.

installDependencies.notes: Node.js 22+, Linux x64, native toolchain. postinstall runs @electron/rebuild for node-pty (Electron 44.4.5 ABI); does not touch global node-gyp or user config.

buildPptist.sourceFetch: git fetch --depth=1 origin 82ecf10040ca8da67832f173b58d3baf5da59887 from https://github.com/pipipi-pikachu/PPTist.git, then git archive the commit and verify the tar SHA-256
buildPptist.build: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build-only inside the fetched tree

buildOmp.sourceFetch: clone https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi, detached checkout c2cb79e4c227aa4b22c4ccb933ff72fd88bceba4 (v18.11.0); download official npm package @oh-my-pi/pi-natives-linux-x64@18.11.0, keep only two pinned .node members verified by SHA-256 (no install scripts run)
buildOmp.build: bun install --frozen-lockfile (Bun 1.3.14), verify pristine source + 3 patch hashes, apply patches, run upstream binary build

packagePortable.preconditions: Linux x64; repository tree fully committed (script refuses otherwise)
outputs: Nozeli-<version>-source.tar.gz (git archive of the release commit; Nozeli-owned sources only)

localArtifacts.notes: The pinned digest in apps/desktop/tools/build-pptist.mjs hashes the uncompressed git-archive tar; this file is its gzip retention copy.
